Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Represents a resource link in the directory, such as chants, songs, schedules, or announcements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Resource entity.

description.description: A brief description of the resource.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the resource was created.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: Represents a weekly schedule for volunteers.

date.description: The Sunday date for this schedule entry.

worship.description: Name of the person leading worship.

offering.description: Name of the person handling the offering.

sermonChant.description: Name of the person leading the sermon chant.

activity.description: Name of the person leading the activity.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an announcement to be displayed in the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

content.description: The main text content of the announcement.

date.description: Date the announcement was created or is relevant to.

Volunteer.title: Volunteer
Volunteer.description: Represents a volunteer who can be assigned to schedule roles.

definition.description: Stores all resources like songs and chants in a single collection. Includes 'resourceId' as document ID.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

definition.description: Stores weekly volunteer/staff roster entries. Includes 'scheduleId' as document ID.

params.name: scheduleId
params.description: The unique identifier of the schedule entry.

definition.description: Stores announcements. Includes 'announcementId' as document ID.

params.name: announcementId
params.description: The unique identifier of the announcement.

definition.description: Stores a list of volunteers available for scheduling. Includes 'volunteerId' as document ID.

params.name: volunteerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the volunteer.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure has been updated. The 'roster_entries' collection has been replaced with a 'schedules' collection to better reflect its purpose. A new 'volunteers' collection has been added to manage the list of people who can be assigned to schedules. This new collection uses a 'Schedule' entity that contains all the roles for a given week in a single document.
